title: The overflow button opens an export menu with Download (PDF) and Download (CSV) in that order
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Find the ⋯ overflow button - the leftmost control in the toolbar's action cluster.
2. Click it and read the menu items top to bottom.
custom_expected:
1. The ⋯ overflow button sits leftmost in the toolbar's action cluster.
2. The menu holds exactly two items, in this order: Download (PDF), then Download (CSV).
